LEASERUNNER
Project Overview:
About LeaseRunner: LeaseRunner is a digital platform that enables landlords to manage the entire rental process—from
tenant screening and e-lease signing to online rent collection—without monthly fees.
Industry Niche: Real Estate & Tenant Screening
Primary Market: United States
Target Audience: Independent landlords, small property managers, real estate professionals, and tenants
Project Timeline: 9-Month Roadmap (November 2024 – August 2025)
Context:
Competitors continuously update content,
landing pages, and services while investing
heavily in branding. As a result, competition is
high; although the content niche is
challenging, it still holds solid SEO potential.
SEO Perspective:
The website’s major weaknesses are declining
traffic, poor UX/UI, and numerous technical
issues—particularly an unoptimized site
structure (URLs, sitemap) that limits both
user experience and indexability.
--> LeaseRunner needs a complete website
overhaul and the development of a focused
niche keyword set for the industry, essentially
rebuilding SEO from the ground up (on-page, off-
page, and fixing over 400 technical URL errors).
Objective:
Restore and grow sustainable traffic after the decline →
increase conversions by targeting keywords for the four
core services.
Implementation Phases
Phase 1 (3–4 months – Critical): Revamp UX/UI and
fix sitewide technical issues. Build new landing pages
for main services. Audit and optimize ~100 existing
blogs.
Phase 2 (3–6+ months): Develop SEO content,
establish keyword direction, strengthen internal
linking, and build a topical map to grow authority.
Phase 3 (Ongoing): Diversify backlink channels—
guest posts, directories, social entities, Web 2.0, link
bios, and selective paid links.
Phase 4 (Parallel & Continuous): Optimize
conversions with CTAs, featured snippets, and A/B
testing; develop new pages/tools to increase user
value.

Result
After implementation, LeaseRunner achieved
strong SEO outcomes:
Organic traffic: 176K clicks, 18.4M
impressions, average CTR 1%
Conversions: 100 successful sign-ups (June
data)
Keyword rankings: 526 in Top 3, 2,778 in Top
4–10, 3,700 in Top 11–20
High-converting Top 1 keywords include
Colorado portable tenant screening, 3x time
the rent, and portable tenant screening
⟶ The website is now within the Top 15 in the
highly competitive tenant-screening market.

GOLDEN OWL SOLUTION
Project Overview – GOS
About GOS: GOS is a technology
outsourcing company providing
custom software development and AI
solutions for global businesses.
Industry Niche: Technology
Project Timeline: 5-Month Roadmap
(July 2024 – November 2024)
SEO Perspective:
For GOS, the site already has
development history and strong
branding. The next step is to pursue a
niche keyword strategy, positioning
“custom software development” as the
core topic instead of solely “IT
outsourcing”—it offers broader search
intent, higher commercial value, and
easier topic clustering around GOS’s
core services.
AI-related keywords will also be
prioritized. Key actions: build a system
of SEO-ready service landing pages,
focus on technical optimization first,
then scale content.
Implementation Plan
Objective: Build a new keyword direction and deploy semantic, topic-based
content to expand non-brand coverage and improve CTR & conversion rate.
Phase 1: Audit existing content and resolve technical issues.
Phase 2: Launch the new keyword set and implement a topical map.
Context: Many strong competitors, such as
Saigontechnology (Top 1 in Vietnam), actively
dominate the “IT outsourcing” topic—an
essential lead-generating area across
Southeast Asia.

TRACNGHIEMTINHCACH.VN
Project Overview
About: An online DISC assessment platform providing personality tests,
detailed reports, and practical recommendations based on the four core
traits: D – Dominance, I – Influence, S – Steadiness, C – Conscientiousness.
Market: Vietnam
Target Audience:
B2C: Students
B2B: HR/Recruiters, Leaders/Managers, Coaches
Industry Niche: EdTech / Personality Assessment / HR Tools
Project Timeline: 3-Month Roadmap (April 2024 – June 2024)
SEO Perspective:
The site is still new, lacks a clear content strategy, and has a thin keyword
structure, resulting in low organic traffic and limited CTR/CR growth. For
this project, the focus is on accelerating Content SEO + Semantic around
the DISC topic to quickly expand non-brand coverage.
Two topic streams will be prioritized:
Trending keywords – fast traffic gains for immediate user acquisition.
Long-term keywords (mental health, workplace) – slower to rank but
build lasting authority and stronger conversion support.
